evidence: Independent source review of the final Mac updater backend, including the exact-child command fence, against feature base 2549daa2e keeps build 1 compatible. New Mac recovery routes require executor ingress and do not change native routes. The native APIClient uses unchanged /api/deployment-status and payload-free SSE contracts, not additive /api/updates Mac fields. Exact Mac termination uses the existing interrupted conversation ending and unchanged view/tail serializers. The later command fence changes only Mac dispatch authority and existing uncertain outcomes; native HTTP, stream, header, and event shapes stay unchanged. Native Swift, build-floor policy, draft storage, and outbox behavior remain unchanged. Fresh guarded checks passed: 14 build-gate unit cases and one real-app integration case for supported reads/action and unsupported read/write/SSE rejection before side effects. Those unchanged native-gate checks remain applicable after the command fence. Parent verification passed the combined backend suites, followed by focused fence cases and full mypy on 1050 files after the fence. Unsigned or signed device execution, live ingress/reconnect, and TestFlight readiness remain untested owner checks.
